recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered collage featuring a vertical split between a photographic portrait of a musician with a guitar and a graphic sidebar containing stylized, ultra-condensed typography and a wavy, organic-shaped border.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical division between photographic realism and flat graphic elements
Contrast between rigid, tall display type and loose, hand-drawn script
Interaction of a wavy pastel shape overlapping a dark, warm-toned photograph
Diagonal banner element cutting across the lower third to create movement

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Musician portrait occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, medium shot scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, red, vertically elongated name in the top left sidebar.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left name, flows down the wavy border to the diagonal banner, then across to the musician's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense with overlapping graphic and photographic layers.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia and earth tones in the photography.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale lavender/lilac for the graphic sidebar background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red for the primary display type and a small heart icon.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red text against desaturated, low-key photographic tones.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Ultra-condensed sans-serif and casual marker script
letterConstructionRules: Display type must have an extreme height-to-width ratio (approx 5:1)
Script type must mimic felt-tip marker strokes with variable baseline
Body text must be a clean, geometric sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Script 'Y' has a long, curved descender
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between rigid architectural display type and organic, casual handwriting.

preserve: Vertical elongation of the main name
The wavy edge of the sidebar
The diagonal tilt of the script banner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme verticality and condensed nature of the display type.
Mimics the felt-tip pen look of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a split composition. On the right, a warm-toned, slightly grainy 1970s-style photograph of a male musician holding an acoustic guitar. On the left, a pale lavender vertical sidebar with a wavy, organic right edge that overlaps the photo. Include a mint-green diagonal banner across the lower third.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-condensed red sans-serif text vertically in the sidebar. Add black hand-drawn marker-style text on the diagonal mint banner. Place a small red heart above the script text. Add a list of song titles in a small, clean sans-serif at the bottom left.

verificationChecks: Is the display type extremely tall and narrow?
Does the wavy border feel organic rather than geometric?
Is the color palette muted except for the red accents?
Does the script text look like it was written with a marker?

adjustableVariables: Saturation of the red accent color
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and song titles
Corporate logos in the bottom right
Exact facial features of the musician
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red text has a thin white outline for legibility.
Check that the wavy border doesn't obscure the musician's face.
Verify the diagonal banner has a slight drop shadow or border to separate it from the background.
Confirm the script text follows the diagonal orientation of the banner.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject Portrait] with [Wavy Pastel Sidebar] + [Ultra-Condensed Red Type] + [Diagonal Marker Script Banner] for a retro-pop aesthetic.
